emergency.label: Emergency services
emergency.guidance: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 911 now.

resources.label: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.guidance: Call, text, or chat 988 for free, confidential crisis support.

resources.label: Crisis Text Line
resources.guidance: Text with a trained crisis counselor.

resources.label: Poison Control
resources.guidance: For a possible poisoning or overdose, call 911 first if there is immediate danger; Poison Control can also help.

resources.label: National Domestic Violence Hotline
resources.guidance: Call, text START to 88788, or chat for confidential support when it is safe to do so.

note: InnerCove is not emergency care and cannot contact services for you.
